# Paperlab dependency notices

Original license and notice files are retained in adjacent versioned folders. Package license labels below are metadata, not a replacement for their complete terms. GSAP has its own custom standard license and is not classified as MIT. Existing project code remains UNLICENSED; the unmodified font retains assets/fonts/OFL.txt and NOTICE.txt.

Scope is taken from positive bytesInOutput in the final esbuild output, not merely parsed inputs. Installed-not-emitted dependencies and their unused model/decoder assets are not part of this browser bundle. Esbuild and its platform executable are build-only. SOURCE.json records exact sources, hashes, scope and bundle hash; existing Electron runtime notices are delivered separately.
